A recent November 18 market report highlighted Bank of America's disclosure of holdings in an XRP exchange-traded fund through its third-quarter regulatory filing.

This is noteworthy because institutional disclosures provide insight into how established financial organisations are gaining exposure to digital assets through regulated investment products.

However, an ETF holding should not be confused with a direct endorsement of every aspect of the XRP Ledger ecosystem. It also does not establish that the bank intends to increase its exposure.

My view: the development is useful for understanding institutional participation, but the bigger picture still depends on fund flows, market liquidity, regulatory developments and actual network utility. One institutional filing cannot determine the asset's future direction.

SECURITIZE — EXPANSION INTO ASSET-BACKED FINANCING

Securitize has announced plans to acquire River Credit Labs, a company developing infrastructure that connects stablecoin capital with traditional lending markets.

The proposed acquisition could expand Securitize's business beyond tokenized asset issuance and servicing into financing infrastructure. This reflects a broader industry trend in which blockchain companies are exploring ways to connect digital assets with conventional financial activities.

The positive possibility is a more integrated platform for tokenized financial products. However, acquisitions require successful completion and integration, and their expected benefits may take time to materialise.

My view: the most important indicators will be the completion of the acquisition, the products eventually introduced and evidence of real customer demand.

$INJ . INJECTIVE — VEYRA UPGRADE AND INSTITUTIONAL TRADING

Injective's proposed Veyra mainnet upgrade is moving through governance ahead of its targeted November 24 activation. The proposed changes include improved cross-chain infrastructure, request-for-quote trading tools and expanded atomic-swap functionality.

These features are relevant because institutional financial markets often require more sophisticated transaction arrangements than ordinary token transfers. The upgrade is also intended to prepare the network for future privacy infrastructure.

The bullish possibility is that improved functionality could make Injective more attractive to developers building tokenized financial applications. The risk is that competition remains strong and the upgrade still needs successful approval and implementation.

My view: watch the governance outcome and technical deployment. The real measure of success will be whether the new features attract sustained usage.

老黄一走

华尔街一窝蜂下调 NVDA 目标价

大家都说是「没了灵魂人物」

1️⃣ 「老黄溢价」是真的，而且有人算出来了 
 Mizuho 说老黄被视为全球 AI 的「造市银行家」和核心创新者。

NVDA 从 10 月高点跌了约 32%，同期 SOX 半导体指数跌约 23%，Mizuho 直说多跌的那段就是「Jensen/创始人溢价」没了。
 10 月 6 日 NVDA 创下历史高点 $243.37。 
多跌的约 9 个百分点，大概就是市场给老黄一个人的标价。

2️⃣ 砍得最狠的那几刀 
 Evercore 从 $465 砍到 $186（-60%）
HSBC 从 $365 砍到 $170
Bernstein 从 $400 砍到 $200
Melius 从 $315 砍到 $185
Truist 从 $346 砍到 $174
 Oppenheimer 下调评级后干脆不给目标价。
 本月给「持有」评级的分析师从 10 月的 2 家增加到 14 家

3️⃣ 但「全部看淡」是错觉 
 S&P Global 追踪的 61 位分析师里，47 位仍给买入，0 位给卖出。
 Citi（$225）
Morgan Stanley（$260）
UBS（$240）
Mizuho（$220）
TD Cowen（$200）虽然降了目标价，评级照样是买入。
 财报后 Wedbush 反而从 $275 上调到 $293。
 多数投行砍的是估值倍数，不是需求。

4️⃣ 砍价的理由不只老黄，还有中国 
 HSBC 指出，过去 6 个季度约 11% 营收来自美国和台湾以外的国家，如果出口限制收紧，FY28 EPS 可能少 13%。
 UBS 估计新的销售限制可能让 2028 年营收少最多 10%。
 Mizuho 认为接下来还有 6 到 7 个月的管理层「悬念期」，因为公司正在被美国政府放大镜检视。

5️⃣ 没有老黄的第一份财报，数字没崩 
 FQ3 营收 $1,158 亿

EPS $2.68

本季营收指引 $1,300 亿

高于 LSEG 共识的 $1,251 亿。
 FY28 营收增长预测从 70% 上调到 75%

而且数据中心算力营收预测没有计入中国。
 Bank of America 形容这次电话会「非常让人安心」
Morgan Stanley 原本以为 NVDA 根本不会更新 FY28 指引。

6️⃣ 真正的不确定，是 3 到 5 年后 
 Bernstein 说董事会已经表明不希望老黄回来。

长线的担心包括供应商谈判、产品路线图、决策速度和人才流失。
 Baird 列出的风险包括更多高管离职、H200 减值、诉讼和罚款，以及客户为 2029 年做「后备方案」导致市占下滑。
 UBS 则认为担心路线图是「过度反应」

整个生态会推着路线图走，新 CEO 也不敢放弃一年一代的节奏。

 老黄确实值钱，市场已经替他标了大约 9 个百分点的溢价。

但这次砍目标价主要砍的是估值倍数，不是订单

短期数字照旧强，指引还上调了。

真正不明朗的是没有老黄之后，3 到 5 年的路线图和谈判力。

答案可能要等正式 CEO 出炉才知道。

你觉得 NVDA 少了老黄，是「便宜上车」还是「价值陷阱」？
